skill.name: senior-backend
skill.description: Comprehensive backend development skill for building scalable backend systems using NodeJS, Express, Go, Python, Postgres, GraphQL, REST APIs. Includes API scaffolding, database optimization, security implementation, and performance tuning. Use when designing APIs, optimizing database queries, implementing business logic, handling authentication/authorization, or reviewing backend code.
skill.summary: Backend development guidance with API, database, security, and performance review helpers.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings in SKILL.md are Markdown examples or inline file names, not executable backtick code. The three helper scripts perform user-directed filesystem writes through --output, and several documented command blocks can alter local or deployment environments if followed without review. No prompt injection, network exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Resolve output paths under a confirmed project directory, reject sensitive file names, and ask before overwriting existing files.
Add confirmation guidance before package installation, container changes, cluster updates, or local helper script execution.

remediation.issue: Environment file setup can overwrite configuration
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to check for an existing .env file before copying example configuration.

content.value_statement: Backend teams need structured guidance for APIs, migrations, security, and performance. This skill provides references and helper scripts for planning, scaffolding, and reviewing backend work.
actual_capabilities: Guides API design decisions for REST, GraphQL, and service boundaries.
Runs local helper scripts for API scaffolding, migration analysis, and load testing.
Summarizes backend security practices for authentication, authorization, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
Provides database optimization guidance for query review, indexing, caching, and migration planning.
Lists backend quality commands for tests, linting, builds, containers, and deployments.
limitations: Helper scripts return placeholder analysis and require project-specific implementation before production use.
Script output depends on local files and command permissions.
The skill does not replace expert security review, load-test design, or database tuning.
Deployment commands must be reviewed before use on shared infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Plan API Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare REST and GraphQL patterns, define service boundaries, and document backend decisions before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Database Changes
use_cases.description: Inspect migrations, indexes, query paths, and performance risks before release.

use_cases.title: Prepare Backend Delivery
use_cases.description: Combine scaffolding, security checklists, and quality commands to standardize backend delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Review an API Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this backend API plan. Identify endpoint design issues, missing validation, security risks, and database concerns. Keep recommendations actionable.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this migration proposal. Check data safety, rollback strategy, indexing, lock risks, and performance impact. Suggest safer alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Design Backend Security
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a backend security review for this service. Cover authentication, authorization, input validation, secret handling, audit logging, and dependency risks.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this backend service for production readiness. Include API reliability, database performance, load testing, observability, deployment risk, and operational runbooks.

output_examples.input: A team asks for review of a new payment API before implementation.
output_examples.output: A prioritized review of endpoint structure, validation gaps, authorization checks, idempotency needs, and database transaction concerns.

output_examples.input: A developer wants to improve a slow migration before release.
output_examples.output: A risk-focused migration review covering lock duration, rollback options, batching, indexes, and monitoring signals.

output_examples.input: A platform lead needs readiness guidance for a new backend service.
output_examples.output: A deployment readiness checklist covering tests, load results, logs, rollback steps, and service ownership.

best_practices: Run helper scripts only after reviewing the target path and output path.
Pair generated guidance with project-specific tests, profiling, and threat modeling.
Confirm infrastructure commands with the responsible team before applying changes.
anti_patterns: Running deployment commands against shared infrastructure without approval.
Treating placeholder script findings as complete production analysis.
Changing authentication, authorization, or data access without a focused security review.

faq.question: Does this skill write files?
faq.answer: Only the helper scripts write JSON reports when an output path is provided.

faq.question: Can it run deployment commands?
faq.answer: The documentation lists deployment commands. Review each command before using it in a real environment.

faq.question: Does it contact external services?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the reviewed scripts. Network behavior may come from commands that users choose to run.

faq.question: Are the scripts production ready?
faq.answer: No. They are lightweight templates and need project-specific logic before production use.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What backend areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers API design, database optimization, backend security, performance checks, and delivery workflows.
